purpose: Local registry and public parcel-geometry source review. Queries were separated by English and local language. No owner, address, tax, or private property fields were queried or retained.
assessment: The governorate operates the Advanced Geospatial Intelligence Complex (MAGIC) and publicizes GIS/surveying services. The national Egyptian General Survey Authority maintains cadastral/topographic map products; official gazette/legal material documents real-property registration sections in Minya Governorate. No public anonymous parcel feature schema or geometry-only point query was verified; maps are supplied through request/product channels. No full polygon was returned; geometry presence remains unverified.
